viewing_check: Confirm timber: look at underside of seat rails and a scratched/unfinished spot for red cedar (open grain, pale-pink to red, light weight, cedar scent) versus mahogany (heavier, close grain). Check for matching set (all 5 same carving/turning), repairs, loose joints, woodworm, rail splits, seat frames original or replaced. Photograph any chalk marks or labels.
